WITH turkish_population AS (
    SELECT 
        gender,
        CASE 
            WHEN age BETWEEN 0 AND 14 THEN '0-14'
            WHEN age BETWEEN 15 AND 24 THEN '15-24'
            WHEN age BETWEEN 25 AND 34 THEN '25-34'
            WHEN age BETWEEN 35 AND 44 THEN '35-44'
            WHEN age BETWEEN 45 AND 54 THEN '45-54'
            WHEN age BETWEEN 55 AND 64 THEN '55-64'
            WHEN age >= 65 THEN '65+'
        END AS age_group,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id, dependent_seq_no) AS count
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
    WHERE TRIM(nationality) = 'تركي'
      AND is_in_population = TRUE
      AND snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala)
    GROUP BY gender, age_group
),
total_turkish AS (
    SELECT SUM(count) AS total FROM turkish_population
),
kingdom_population AS (
    SELECT 
        gender,
        CASE 
            WHEN age BETWEEN 0 AND 14 THEN '0-14'
            WHEN age BETWEEN 15 AND 24 THEN '15-24'
            WHEN age BETWEEN 25 AND 34 THEN '25-34'
            WHEN age BETWEEN 35 AND 44 THEN '35-44'
            WHEN age BETWEEN 45 AND 54 THEN '45-54'
            WHEN age BETWEEN 55 AND 64 THEN '55-64'
            WHEN age >= 65 THEN '65+'
        END AS age_group,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id, dependent_seq_no) AS count
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
    WHERE is_in_population = TRUE
      AND snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala)
    GROUP BY gender, age_group
),
total_kingdom AS (
    SELECT SUM(count) AS total FROM kingdom_population
)
SELECT 
    'السكان الأتراك' AS population_type,
    tp.gender,
    tp.age_group,
    tp.count,
    ROUND(tp.count * 100.0 / tt.total, 2) AS percentage
FROM turkish_population tp
CROSS JOIN total_turkish tt
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'متوسط المملكة' AS population_type,
    kp.gender,
    kp.age_group,
    kp.count,
    ROUND(kp.count * 100.0 / tk.total, 2) AS percentage
FROM kingdom_population kp
CROSS JOIN total_kingdom tk
ORDER BY population_type, gender, age_group LIMIT 20000
